checks.name: Backend verify incl. CookWorkspaceIntegrationTest and identity returnTo (PostgreSQL, Keycloak)
Clean-clone workspace incl. contract lint/drift and registry parity
Cook workspace browser workflow against the real local stack (Playwright, Chromium)

scenarios.observed: scripts/dev.sh e2e (throwaway PostgreSQL, Keycloak, S3 emulator, API; operations web dev server; Chromium): cook-a signs in through Keycloak and sees no kitchen and no application; after synthetic approval the dashboard shows the kitchen; the cook creates a meal with an uploaded PNG photo (signed upload verified and approved by the server), publishes it, creates a slot for tomorrow and opens it. customer-a signs in (operations web shows no kitchen; GET /cook/dashboard 403), adds an address and places one pickup and one delivery order through the real API. The cook sees both on the dashboard with server-time deadlines, accepts, prepares and marks both ready; sees the delivery contact and address; a wrong pickup handover code shows the verification error and the customer's real code completes it; the delivery order is dispatched with a reference and completed with the customer's code. A cash report on the completed pickup order makes it REPORTED (also in the customer's order view); the statement lists both orders with the coverage note; pausing sales blocks a new quote and resuming allows it; the UI switches from Arabic RTL to English LTR. CookWorkspaceIntegrationTest (5): own-kitchen dashboard, other cook's order 404, customer 403; pause/resume and staff pause/suspension rules (409), serviceability/zone/version validation, public profile update, audit; statement lines, posted commission 2400 of 24000, period/cursor validation, other cook empty. Identity: returnTo honoured only for allowed origins (6 cases). Operations web component tests (9). Mutations: stale version from the UI and an open returnTo both failed tests.

findings: Defect fixed before commit: resume on a suspended kitchen returned 200 without change; now 409.
returnTo restricted to exact configured origins with absolute paths; covered against real Keycloak.
Brand guard (TC-103) kept; API client factory renamed instead.

Residual: synthetic SQL approval and phone verification in the browser workflow (local MFA/SMS unavailable); cross-site cookie/CSRF arrangement for deployed domains decided with hosting (P09); Chromium only; browser workflow not yet in GitHub CI; refunds/remittances MB-025.
